vb_textbox.text: I advise you to stay focused and keep your mind on the game, as it tends to wander. Try to stay calm and take a deep breaths. Take it in turns with which gnome to choose so that you give your fingers a break. Take advantage of the 5 minute breaks if you need them and make sure you are in a quiet place where you will not be disturbed and have a glass of water beside you. Goodluck.
